company_name: Toyohashi University of Technology, Integrated Biosensor and MEMS Group
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — while the company focuses on sensor and MEMS technologies, it operates within the semiconductor domain primarily through research and development rather than direct supply.
summary: The Integrated Biosensor and MEMS Group at Toyohashi University of Technology specializes in developing integrated biosensor systems and MEMS-based hybrid sensor devices. Their research contributes to various fields including medical diagnostics and life sciences, leveraging advanced LSI technologies.
